can_do: I can introduce family or friends with simple phrases.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Leo, Mia, Emma, and Toto find photo cards. They make a friendly tree poster. You can use family cards or friend cards.
repair_link: Use a card first, then choose one short line.

can_do: I can recognize family and friend words.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Look at the word cards. Listen and point: mom, dad, sister, brother, grandma, grandpa, friend, dog.
repair_link: Match picture to word again. Say only the word first.

can_do: I can say This is my... with a photo card.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Mia shows a card. Leo listens. Use the frame: This is my ___.
repair_link: Start with This is my, then add one card word.

can_do: I can ask and answer Who's this?
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Leo points to a mystery card. Mia answers with a short line.
repair_link: Question: Who's this? Answer: It's my ___.

can_do: I can introduce a friend or Toto.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Emma shows a friend card. You can make a poster with family cards or friend cards.
repair_link: If you do not want to use a family card, use a friend card.

can_do: I can read very short family/friend lines.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Read the big cards: This is my mom. This is my dad. This is my friend.
repair_link: Read the picture first, then read the line.

can_do: I can plan my family/friend poster.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Choose 3 or 4 cards. Put them on a tree poster. Copy or choose the sentence frame.
repair_link: Use the phrase bank. Do not write long sentences.

can_do: I can show my poster and say 3–4 lines.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Mia shows her poster. Leo and Emma listen. Toto sits near the poster.
repair_link: Use 3 lines, clear voice, and smile.

can_do: I can understand a short family/friend story.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Watch a short silent/captioned story. Toto finds photo cards. The team makes a tree poster.
repair_link: Replay with captions. Match each caption to a picture.

can_do: I can make and present a poster.
kp_target: family/friend words; This is my ___; Who's this?; It's my ___
lesson_input: Make a poster with 3 or 4 cards. Use family cards, friend cards, or Toto. Say your lines.
repair_link: Check: 3 lines, clear voice, smile. Use the phrase bank if needed.
